evidence: The PUBLISHED CVE.org record at https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-28342 states that before 3000.10.2 unauthenticated concurrent PasswordHash requests can exhaust memory and cause denial of service.

Vendor advisory https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/security/advisories/GHSA-pc8g-78pf-4xrp identifies POST /api/olivetin.api.v1.OliveTinApiService/PasswordHash, no authentication/throttling/resource limit, and about 64 MiB per concurrent request.

At 1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222, OliveTin.proto exposes POST /api/PasswordHash; internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go passes attacker-controlled req.Password to createHash; internal/grpcapi/local_user_login.go calls argon2id.CreateHash with Memory 64*1024 and no admission limit.

git log --follow -S'func (api *oliveTinAPI) PasswordHash' -- internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go and -S'Memory:      64 * 1024' -- internal/grpcapi/local_user_login.go both identify 1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222 as the first writer.

git show 1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222 shows the same single commit adding the public PasswordHash RPC/HTTP route, its handler, and the 64 MiB Argon2 sink; later a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404 is a code-move/rewrite carrier, not the BIC.
git rev-list --parents -n 1 1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222 gives sole parent 71ad5d2e3a14fae7755b2e856981f50887745558.

git grep 'PasswordHash|defaultParams|createHash' 71ad5d2e3a14fae7755b2e856981f50887745558 finds none of the vulnerable route or hashing implementation; git diff parent..BIC records OliveTin.proto and internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go modified and internal/grpcapi/local_user_login.go newly added.

The public BIC object and https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/commit/1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222 show one parent and the first surviving public implementation; it is not a merge, move, revert, or later advisory carrier, and no finer public first-write member appears in the followed path history.

bug_semantics: An unauthenticated caller can submit arbitrary passwords to the public PasswordHash HTTP/RPC method. Each request synchronously enters argon2id.CreateHash with a 64 MiB memory parameter and no authentication, rate limit, queue, or concurrency admission control; parallel requests therefore multiply memory consumption until OliveTin degrades, crashes, or is killed.
flaw_origin: 1af2e921323ee0ba3bf3d922c8861652d3913222 is the smallest surviving public first-writer: in one single-parent feature commit it introduced the PasswordHash request and public route, the handler forwarding attacker input, and the unrestricted 64 MiB Argon2 hash implementation. Its immediate parent has none of those lines; later path moves and merge carriers do not supersede it.

reasoning: The authoritative CVE and vendor advisory confirm a real, non-withdrawn vulnerability. Git history closes the source-to-sink lifecycle: a named-human single-parent BIC first exposed unrestricted 64 MiB Argon2 hashing to unauthenticated callers, its immediate parent lacks the mechanism, affected tag 3000.10.0 contains the BIC but not the fix, and fixed tag 3000.10.2 contains the decomposed direct semaphore fix. Because the BIC object itself has a named human author/committer and no causal AI marker, all eight gates pass and the correct verdict is NOT_AI.
